_comment: PUBLISHED TAGS ARE PROMISES. README tells consumers to add this repository as a git submodule, and a submodule is pinned by SHA or by tag — so moving a published tag relocates somebody else's pin onto a different tree, silently. This snapshot makes 'no published tag moved' a checkable statement instead of a recollection: tests/test_published_tags_are_promises.py compares a live ls-remote against it via publication_scope.tags_unmoved, and treats appearing and vanishing as movement too.
_how_taken: git ls-remote --tags github, peeled objects (refs/tags/<name>^{}) where present
